title: Sayyeda ka mohsin hai
body:
Haye Zahra... Haye Mohsin... Haye Zahra...
Be 'aay e zambin- qutilat...
<<MINI>>
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hua shahid jo deewar-o dar ke beech aakar
Jise bachaane se zakhmi hai pehlu-e maadar
Udaas iske liye raat ghumzada din hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Woh jisne karbobala ka safar kiya hi nahi
Zabaa'n se jisne abhi maa ko maa kaha hi nahi
Woh jhulta kisi jhule me kya yeh manzar hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ali ne aisa janaza kaha'n uthaya hai
Shaheed hoke jo maidaan-e ghum me aaya hai
Woh sheerkhwar jo na waaqif e qadosin hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Woh jisko ghusl-o-kafan ki kaha'n zaroorat thi
Woh jiske tann pe ba-misle khuda taharat thi
Jo karbala ki zamee'n ka imam-e zamin hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Chupa rahe hai musalma'n isi shaheed ki baat
Gawaah jiski shahadat ki hai Khuda ki zaat
Yeh qatl sab pe ayaa'n hai kaha'n yeh baatil hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Qasam Khuda ki ba-misle Hussain ibn-e Ali
Shaheed hogaya lekin madad kisi ki na li
Malool iske liye qaum-e-Zaafare jinn hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Isi ke azm ki taqleed ki hai Asghar ne
Ise shaheed kiya hai sitam ke lashkar ne
Malool teghe Ali is shaheed ke binn hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Firaaq-e hazrate Mohsin me margayi Zahra
Kisi bhi maa pe na utre yeh be-amaa'n sadma
Yeh dard samjhega 'Rehan' jo bhi mo'min hai...
<<MINI>>
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
Hassan Hussain se pehle shahid-e kamsin hai...
Woh koi aur nahi, Sayyada ka Mohsin hai...
